blocks.text: Block-based website builder with 550+ pre-designed sections

Tilda takes a building-block approach to web design. With over 550 pre-designed sections, you assemble pages by stacking and customizing professional blocks rather than designing from scratch. This approach dramatically reduces the time to create polished pages.

Each block is designed by professional designers and covers common patterns - hero sections, feature grids, team pages, pricing tables, galleries, and more. The result is that even non-designers can produce sites that look cohesive and professional.

For content-heavy sites - magazines, editorial platforms, portfolios - Tilda particularly excels. The typography and whitespace handling are refined in ways that most no-code builders overlook. Your content gets the visual treatment it deserves.
Professional pre-designed sections for every common page pattern
Pixel-perfect design freedom for fully custom sections
E-commerce with shopping cart, payment processing, and order management
Scroll and entrance animations with a visual timeline editor
Send form data directly to popular CRMs and email tools
Advanced type settings including Google Fonts and custom font uploads

When clients need a content-rich website that looks editorially polished, Tilda's block system delivers faster than any alternative we have tested. The design quality of the pre-built blocks is exceptional.
Our team can integrate Tilda into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
